name: Fragmento
source:
In a city far from everywhere, a mirror changes the whole life of a student. Bianca needs to escape from all the horror in her life and decide whether to keep her relationships.

[From [url=https://fragmentadas.itch.io/fragmento]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个远离一切的城市，一面镜子改变了学生的一生。比安卡需要逃离生活中的所有恐怖，并决定是否维持她的人际关系。

[来自[url=https://fragmentadas.itch.io/fragmento]Itch.io[/url]]
